caption: The payroll file's access list names raj, bob, group hr and root in scan order, and bob's read right has since been copied into four processes. Every copy is a place that revocation must reach.

spec.title: One access list and the copies of one right
spec.aria: The payroll file access list gives raj read-write, bob read, group hr read and root read-write, and bob's read right has been copied into processes P1, P4, P9 and P12.
